title: [AUG-204] Compact widgets: always-visible way back and non-blocking first-time hint (UI audit T1)
why_we_need_this: UI audit AUG-203 (@docs/reviews/2026-11-ui-audit.md, findings F-14, F-03, F-15, F-41, F-44): on the first recording the window collapses into a Dock Square or Dock Strip, the one-time hint covers the timer and the action-items header, and the `[ Expand ]` button is clipped at the default 360 px strip width and absent at 280 px. A first-time user cannot find the way back to the full window and believes the app vanished. Ghost Caption controls are 13×16 px icon-only buttons; the Dock Square during Live shows an unlabelled counter. This is the single most damaging first-run moment.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Dock Strip header keeps timer, status, `[ CP ]`, `[ AS ]`, `[ ⇄ ]` and `[ Expand ]` fully visible at every width from 280 to 520 px (header wraps to two rows or the right-aligned cluster never shrinks); verified by screenshots at 280, 360 and 520 px
- [ ] Dock Square and Dock Strip first-time hint ("Snap your call into the freed space") never overlaps the timer, level bars or the ACTION ITEMS header and `[ + ADD ]`; it says that recording continues and names the control that restores the window
- [ ] Ghost Caption hover tools have hit areas of at least 24×24 px with visible short labels (End, Mute, Expand …); the End control is always visible in red, not hover-only
- [ ] Dock Square in Live labels its line counter ("2 lines") and the `⇄` switch has a visible caption or tooltip
- [ ] The amber "Groq off — only manual items" box is replaced by plain wording ("Action items: add by hand" + link to turn automatic items on)
- [ ] Both platforms: no `process.platform` regression; Ghost window layout verified on Windows and listed as pending on macOS if not checked
- [ ] Brandbook kept: 0 border-radius, Necron tokens, red only on End / destructive
important_constraints:
Screenshots for repro: @docs/reviews/2026-11-ui-audit/25-default-recording-main.png, @docs/reviews/2026-11-ui-audit/84-live-dockstrip-main.png, @docs/reviews/2026-11-ui-audit/92-dockstrip-min280.png. Files: client/src/components/compact/DockWidgets.tsx, CompactLayer.tsx, GhostApp.tsx, electron/src/compact.ts (STRIP_MIN / header width), client/src/App.css compact sections. Do not change the restore mechanics (setCompactMode none, Esc); only visibility, layout and copy. No diagnostic numbers in user-facing text.

Order: 2/3 (UI audit AUG-203 layout follow-ups). Independent of AUG-206 and AUG-205 (compact windows only). Related: AUG-205, AUG-206.
